I am narrating my harrowing experience with him yesterday regarding my yellow fever vaccination appointment for three of us - my husband, my 5 YO son and for myself.
Never in my life have I met an arrogant, impolite, vainglorious human being as Viraj Sadrani.
Let me give you a background. Cost of a yellow fever vaccine in any Govt establishment is Rs.300 per dose, however I paid Rs. 2500 per dose - that's Rs 7500 for the three of us- more than 8 times the actual price!  When you pay a premium , you expect a service complimenting that - forget about service , this guy walked in  1 and a half hour late and with zero remorse. When I interjected and said I am not the one shouting here, you are ; like am immature kid, he dragged his assistant into this conversation and started asking- tu bata koun chilla raha hai ! Imagine the level of immaturity and unprofessionalism he has!
Not just this , he also threw his weight around citing twice that he was a DOCTOR! As if we were some uneducated goons sitting infront of him! This entire experience was so disturbing for all three of us specially  for my child that he broke into tears towards the end!

All we needed was a simple 'Sorry' but that would have meant stooping too low for this egoist person- forget about him apologising, I had to apologise to him at the end to ease out the tension there!

Think twice before reaching out to this unprofessional doctor in future- remember he is not the last doctor remaining on this Earth- there is no dearth of Doctors  !

It's high time doctors started treating us as their customers and not as mere patients in dire need of them . We pay for their services and they better learn punctuality and professionalism.

featured_reviews.review_text:

It is very upsetting that I have to choose this method to convey my thoughts about the diagnostic lab. I went there for my sister's blood check up and as a lay man we took the reports given to us. To which the other person some colleague of the receptionist blatantly said uska paisa nai liya hoga aapse(very rudely). I presented the bill and they were left speechless. Then after 10 mins they got me the reports saying these are her reports which us absolutely untrustworthy. You guys had no idea about the report 10 mins ago and then suddenly got this generated report!!!! One more test demanded 2 different reports (I mentioned it atleast 5 times during the test). They didn't deliver that as well. The receptionist called me up the next day and shamelessly said vo change karke nai milega jaisa hai waisa hi milega. Sad to know that diagnostic centres have become so inconsiderate and do not care at all. They have forgotten the fact that they are dealing with patients and the treatment depends on their results. Never going here again. Please choose wisely!
